Hi Jeff —

Thanks again for the time on last week's discovery. We'd like to lock a dedicated readout to walk through the latency/throughput benchmarks we ran against your sample workload and to go over the recommended runtime knobs. Suggested format: a 60–90 minute session (45 min readout + 30 min Q&A) with your engineering, procurement, and security leads.

Two initial options from our side (PST):
- Thu, Dec 3 | 10:00–11:30 (PT)
- Mon, Dec 6 | 13:00–14:30 (PT)

If neither works, happy to propose alternate slots — can you confirm who from Stratus should join beyond your engineering lead?

Attachments: agenda_v1.docx (draft)

Thanks,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
+aisha@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

Aisha —

Thanks for the options. We do want a slightly longer slot — 90 minutes would be safer given the number of stakeholders. Please include our procurement lead (Maya Ortiz) and our InfoSec alias (security@stratusanalytics.com). Also: can we request access to the pre-read (raw results/spreadsheets) ahead of the meeting? Procurement will want cost/unit assumptions.

Preferable times for us:
- Fri, Dec 4 | 14:00–15:30 (PT)
- Tue, Dec 7 | 09:30–11:00 (PT)

Let me know if you can accommodate Fri the 4th. If not, we can do Tue 7th.

Best,
